CustomField.description: Org-wide "Hide Decline Button" master switch (#367). Unchecked (the default) — the signer's "Decline to Sign" button shows on every signing page. Check it to hide Decline everywhere, regardless of per-template settings. While it is unchecked, an individual template can still hide Decline for itself via Hide_Signer_Decline__c (source-document sends with no template follow this switch alone). Resolved live on every signing-page load (DocGenSignatureController.validateToken), not stamped at send time, so flipping this reaches already-sent, still-pending signature requests too.
CustomField.label: Hide Decline Button
